context: Planning a school field trip to the museum
purpose: Plan a school trip; teach 国立/千葉/２月/８月/１０月/１２月/男女/３つ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 学校の社会見学先に、国立美術館はどうでしょう。
lines.en: For the school field trip, how about the national museum?
lines.style: planner proposing politely, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 千葉の本館、設備も整っていますね。
lines.en: The Chiba main building is well equipped too.
lines.style: manager endorsing, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ２月か８月、どちらの展示が学習向きですか？
lines.en: February or August — which show suits learning?
lines.style: planner weighing options, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: １０月の歴史展も、教科書と関連します。
lines.en: October’s history show ties to the textbook too.
lines.style: manager offering an alternative, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: １２月は混むので、避けたいですね。
lines.en: December gets crowded, so I’d avoid it.
lines.style: cautious planner ruling out, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 男女別の班分けで、効率よく回れます。
lines.en: Splitting by gender keeps the tour efficient.
lines.style: manager suggesting logistics, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ３つの展示室を、半日で巡れますよ。
lines.en: You can cover three rooms in half a day.
lines.style: planner confirming feasibility, each word carrying genuine natural feeling
